blocks.en_text: Hi Georgie.
blocks.zh_text: 嗨，Georgie。

blocks.en_text: Hi Phil. How are you?
blocks.zh_text: 嗨，Phil。你好吗？

blocks.en_text: I'm good, I'm good.
blocks.zh_text: 我很好，我很好。

blocks.en_text: I wanted to ask if you've been to any famous places or landmarks
blocks.zh_text: 我想问问你最近有没有去过伦敦的什么著名的地方或者地标。

blocks.en_text: in London recently.
blocks.zh_text: 就在伦敦。

blocks.en_text: It's funny you should ask, because I did.
blocks.zh_text: 你问得真巧，我还真去了。

blocks.en_text: A few days ago, I went to the Royal Albert Hall, which is
blocks.zh_text: 几天前，我去了皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅，那是

blocks.en_text: a famous concert hall in London.
blocks.zh_text: 伦敦一座著名的音乐厅。

blocks.en_text: OK. So, Georgie, today we're talking about landmarks – British landmarks.
blocks.zh_text: 好。那么，Georgie，今天我们要聊的是地标——英国的地标。

blocks.en_text: Now, those are famous buildings like the Royal Albert Hall or like...
blocks.zh_text: 就是那些著名的建筑，比如皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅，或者像……

blocks.en_text: like Big Ben in London.
blocks.zh_text: 比如伦敦的大本钟。

blocks.en_text: That's a really famous landmark that everyone knows.
blocks.zh_text: 那是一个非常著名的地标，人人都知道。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, that's a famous clock tower,
blocks.zh_text: 对，那是一座著名的钟楼，

blocks.en_text: but before we start talking about landmarks,
blocks.zh_text: 不过在开始聊地标之前，

blocks.en_text: I need to remind people that they can download a free worksheet
blocks.zh_text: 我需要提醒大家，他们可以下载一份免费的学习单

blocks.en_text: to test the vocabulary they learn in this programme,
blocks.zh_text: 来测试他们在这个节目里学到的词汇，

blocks.en_text: at bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 网址是 bbclearningenglish.com。

blocks.en_text: OK.
blocks.zh_text: 好。

blocks.en_text: So, Georgie, you just said you'd been to the Royal Albert Hall, which is
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Georgie，你刚才说你去了皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅，那是

blocks.en_text: a famous concert hall in London.
blocks.zh_text: 伦敦一座著名的音乐厅。

blocks.en_text: Why did you go there?
blocks.zh_text: 你为什么去那儿呢？

blocks.en_text: I went to a classical music concert,
blocks.zh_text: 我去听了一场古典音乐会，

blocks.en_text: but this was not the first time I've been to the Royal Albert Hall.
blocks.zh_text: 不过这不是我第一次去皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅。

blocks.en_text: No?
blocks.zh_text: 不是？

blocks.en_text: No, I actually performed there with my choir last year.
blocks.zh_text: 不是，其实我去年还和我的合唱团在那儿演出过。

blocks.en_text: It was... it was amazing.
blocks.zh_text: 那真是……真是太棒了。

blocks.en_text: Oh wow!
blocks.zh_text: 哇哦！

blocks.en_text: Phil, have you visited any famous landmarks in London?
blocks.zh_text: Phil，你去过伦敦的什么著名地标吗？

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I think...
blocks.zh_text: 去过，我觉得……

blocks.en_text: I think I've probably visited most of the famous ones.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得那些著名的地标我大概都去过了。

blocks.en_text: I've been on the London Eye.
blocks.zh_text: 我坐过伦敦眼。

blocks.en_text: That's the big wheel.
blocks.zh_text: 就是那个大摩天轮。

blocks.en_text: I've been to Tower Bridge lots of times.
blocks.zh_text: 我去过伦敦塔桥好多次。

blocks.en_text: I've been in the Houses of Parliament.
blocks.zh_text: 我进过议会大厦。

blocks.en_text: That's right by Big Ben, where the government is.
blocks.zh_text: 就在大本钟旁边，是政府所在地。

blocks.en_text: Phil, why have you been in the Houses of Parliament?
blocks.zh_text: Phil，你为什么进议会大厦呢？

blocks.en_text: It was just something for work, so it wasn't that interesting,
blocks.zh_text: 就是工作上的事，所以没那么有意思，

blocks.en_text: but it's good to see the building.
blocks.zh_text: 不过看看这座建筑还是挺好的。

blocks.en_text: You see it from outside all the time,
blocks.zh_text: 你总是从外面看它，

blocks.en_text: and it's kind of interesting to see it from the inside. It's really...
blocks.zh_text: 从里面看看还挺有意思的。它真的……

blocks.en_text: it's a very beautiful building as well, I think.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得它也是一座非常漂亮的建筑。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, it is. So, you've been to a lot of landmarks in London.
blocks.zh_text: 对，确实。那么，你去过伦敦的很多地标。

blocks.en_text: Do you have a favourite one?
blocks.zh_text: 你有最喜欢的一个吗？

blocks.en_text: My favourite one is actually the river.
blocks.zh_text: 我最喜欢的其实是那条河。

blocks.en_text: I love going up and down the river on a boat.
blocks.zh_text: 我很喜欢坐船在河上来来回回。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I really like the river too.
blocks.zh_text: 是啊，我也真的很喜欢那条河。

blocks.en_text: My favourite landmark in London is the Tower of London.
blocks.zh_text: 我在伦敦最喜欢的地标是伦敦塔。

blocks.en_text: I went with my dad.
blocks.zh_text: 我是和我爸爸一起去的。

blocks.en_text: It's a very, very old building.
blocks.zh_text: 那是一座非常非常古老的建筑。

blocks.en_text: I think in history a lot of people died there, so it has a kind of spooky...
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得历史上有很多人在那里死去，所以它有一种阴森森的……

blocks.en_text: a spooky feeling there.
blocks.zh_text: 那里有一种阴森森的感觉。

blocks.en_text: But it's quite a large area you can walk around and,
blocks.zh_text: 但那是一片挺大的区域，你可以四处走走，而且，

blocks.en_text: yeah, it all just feels really old and quite special.
blocks.zh_text: 对，整体感觉就是非常古老，而且挺特别的。

blocks.en_text: OK. So, we've been talking about London,
blocks.zh_text: 好。我们一直在聊伦敦，

blocks.en_text: but what about the rest of Britain, Georgie?
blocks.zh_text: 那英国其他地方呢，Georgie？

blocks.en_text: What's your favourite landmark in the rest of Britain?
blocks.zh_text: 英国其他地方你最喜欢的标志性景点是哪里？

blocks.en_text: Ooh, I can't wait to talk about this!
blocks.zh_text: 哦，我太想聊这个了！

blocks.en_text: One of my favourite places in the UK is Edinburgh,
blocks.zh_text: 我在英国最喜欢的地方之一是爱丁堡，

blocks.en_text: which is the capital of Scotland.
blocks.zh_text: 它是苏格兰的首府。

blocks.en_text: And in the city, they have – in the middle of the city,
blocks.zh_text: 在这座城市里，他们有一块——在市中心，

blocks.en_text: they have a big black rock, like a hill.
blocks.zh_text: 他们有一块巨大的黑色岩石，像一座小山。

blocks.en_text: And on the top, there is the castle, Edinburgh Castle,
blocks.zh_text: 山顶上就是那座城堡，爱丁堡城堡，

blocks.en_text: and it's so beautiful.
blocks.zh_text: 它太美了。

blocks.en_text: I used to live there when I was at university and
blocks.zh_text: 我上大学的时候曾住在那里，而且

blocks.en_text: every time I walked past it, I was...
blocks.zh_text: 每次我路过它，我都……

blocks.en_text: I felt like a tourist every day.
blocks.zh_text: 我每天都感觉自己像个游客。

blocks.en_text: I was always taking photos of it because it looks unreal.
blocks.zh_text: 我总在给它拍照，因为它看起来不真实。

blocks.en_text: It doesn't look... It looks like it's from a storybook.
blocks.zh_text: 它看起来不……它看起来就像童话书里的一样。

blocks.en_text: It's magical, I love it.
blocks.zh_text: 它很有魔力，我很喜欢。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I love Edinburgh.
blocks.zh_text: 是啊，我很喜欢爱丁堡。

blocks.en_text: I went there one year for New Year and it was...
blocks.zh_text: 有一年新年我去过那里，那真是……

blocks.en_text: It's amazing. You can feel the history.
blocks.zh_text: 太棒了。你能感受到那里的历史。

blocks.en_text: There're so many old buildings and it's... yeah, it's very dramatic.
blocks.zh_text: 那里有好多古老的建筑，而且……对，非常震撼。

blocks.en_text: I did a guided tour there actually once.
blocks.zh_text: 其实我有一次在那里参加了一个导览游。

blocks.en_text: It was around Halloween, so it was a kind of spooky-themed guided tour.
blocks.zh_text: 那是在万圣节前后，所以算是一个阴森主题的导览游。

blocks.en_text: They took us to a graveyard and they told us stories about witches,
blocks.zh_text: 他们带我们去了一个墓地，给我们讲了关于女巫的故事，

blocks.en_text: and that was really exciting.
blocks.zh_text: 那真的特别刺激。

blocks.en_text: I like guided tours.
blocks.zh_text: 我喜欢导览游。

blocks.en_text: Oh yeah, that sounds exciting.
blocks.zh_text: 哦对，听起来很刺激。

blocks.en_text: So, Phil, do you enjoy sightseeing?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Phil，你喜欢观光吗？

blocks.en_text: So, when you see lots of different landmarks in a city or a country.
blocks.zh_text: 就是在一座城市或一个国家里看到很多不同的标志性景点。

blocks.en_text: I do, yes.
blocks.zh_text: 我喜欢，是的。

blocks.en_text: I think usually when you go sightseeing you see lots of old buildings, usually.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得通常观光的时候，你会看到很多古老的建筑，一般都是这样。

blocks.en_text: And they often give you an idea of how people used to live,
blocks.zh_text: 它们常常能让你了解人们过去是怎么生活的，

blocks.en_text: how people lived in the past, and I find that really interesting.
blocks.zh_text: 过去的人是怎么生活的，我觉得这特别有意思。

blocks.en_text: So yes, if I visit a new city, I almost always go sightseeing at some point.
blocks.zh_text: 所以是的，如果我去一座新城市，我几乎总会在某个时候去观光。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I really like sightseeing as well.
blocks.zh_text: 是啊，我也很喜欢观光。

blocks.en_text: You can see lots of a city, or it's the best way to see a place, I think,
blocks.zh_text: 你能看到一座城市的很多地方，我觉得这是了解一个地方最好的方式，

blocks.en_text: when you visit somewhere new.
blocks.zh_text: 当你去一个新地方的时候。

blocks.en_text: It can be quite exhausting though, can't it?
blocks.zh_text: 不过这也挺累人的，对吧？

blocks.en_text: Especially if you're walking all over the city to see all
blocks.zh_text: 尤其是当你要走遍整座城市去看所有这些

blocks.en_text: of these different landmarks.
blocks.zh_text: 不同的地标的时候。

blocks.en_text: So, Phil, my favourite UK landmark is Edinburgh Castle.
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Phil，我最喜欢的英国地标是爱丁堡城堡。

blocks.en_text: Do you have a favourite?
blocks.zh_text: 你有最喜欢的吗？

blocks.en_text: Yes. I think it's got to be
blocks.zh_text: 有。我觉得一定是

blocks.en_text: Stonehenge, just because it is so old.
blocks.zh_text: 巨石阵，就因为它太古老了。

blocks.en_text: It's thousands of years old.
blocks.zh_text: 它有几千年的历史了。

blocks.en_text: I don't think I've seen anything else that's that old.
blocks.zh_text: 我想我没见过别的什么东西有那么古老。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. So, the Stonehenge is in England and
blocks.zh_text: 对。所以，巨石阵在英格兰，

blocks.en_text: it's a circle or a ring of really big, tall stones.
blocks.zh_text: 它是一圈或一环非常巨大、高耸的石头。

blocks.en_text: And humans put it up and
blocks.zh_text: 是人类把它立起来的，

blocks.en_text: it's really amazing because it's not fully known how they did it,
blocks.zh_text: 这真的很了不起，因为人们并不完全清楚他们是怎么做到的，

blocks.en_text: because the rocks are so heavy.
blocks.zh_text: 因为这些石头太重了。

blocks.en_text: So, if anyone comes to the UK to visit,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，如果有人来英国旅游，

blocks.en_text: I would really recommend going to see that.
blocks.zh_text: 我真的会推荐去看看它。

blocks.en_text: So, let's look at some of the words that we talked about today.
blocks.zh_text: 那么，我们来看看今天谈到的一些单词。

blocks.en_text: And the big one was 'landmark',
blocks.zh_text: 最重要的一个是“landmark”（地标），

blocks.en_text: and those are famous buildings or famous places that people visit,
blocks.zh_text: 指的是人们参观的著名建筑或著名地点，

blocks.en_text: and usually they know what they look like beforehand, often.
blocks.zh_text: 而且通常他们事先就知道它们长什么样，很多时候是这样。

blocks.en_text: Yes. For example, the London Eye.
blocks.zh_text: 对。比如伦敦眼。

blocks.en_text: We also heard 'sightseeing', which is when you visit landmarks and famous places
blocks.zh_text: 我们还听到了“sightseeing”（观光），指的是你参观一个城市或国家里的地标和著名地点

blocks.en_text: in a city or country.
blocks.zh_text: 的时候。

blocks.en_text: Yes. And one of the ways that you can do sightseeing
blocks.zh_text: 对。而观光的方式之一

blocks.en_text: is you can go on a guided tour,
blocks.zh_text: 就是参加有导游的游览，

blocks.en_text: and that's when someone, a guide, leads you around different places
blocks.zh_text: 就是有人，一位导游，带着你逛不同的地方

blocks.en_text: and they tell you about the history of all those places.
blocks.zh_text: 并给你讲所有这些地方的历史。

blocks.en_text: So, Georgie, we're out of time.
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Georgie，我们时间到了。

blocks.en_text: That's it for Real Easy English for this week.
blocks.zh_text: 本周的Real Easy English就到这里。

blocks.en_text: But if you like landmarks, make sure you go to our website
blocks.zh_text: 但如果你喜欢地标，一定要去我们的网站

blocks.en_text: to check out the London Letter Challenge,
blocks.zh_text: 看看London Letter Challenge，

blocks.en_text: where you can see lots of different landmarks and learn easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 在那里你可以看到许多不同的地标，还能学简单的英语。

blocks.en_text: And you can find a free worksheet
blocks.zh_text: 你还可以找到免费的练习表

blocks.en_text: and transcript on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 和文字稿，就在我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上。

blocks.en_text: Goodbye for now.
blocks.zh_text: 先再见啦。

blocks.en_text: Bye!
blocks.zh_text: 拜拜！
